summary: Checkpoint scrubber for a coding session: each jump runs a rewind glitch over the code, and changed lines get a green bar.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Heading text. Read once on connect.

events.name: preview
events.description: Fires when the head moves to another checkpoint by drag, click or key.

events.name: restore
events.description: Fires when Restore is pressed, including on the latest checkpoint.

accessibility: The timeline is focusable with `role="slider"`, `aria-label="Checkpoint"`, `aria-valuemin="0"`, `aria-valuemax="4"`, `aria-valuenow` and the checkpoint name as `aria-valuetext`.
The code pane is not a live region; the slider's `aria-valuetext` names the checkpoint as it moves.
Restore is a native button; its result message below is an `aria-live="polite"` region.
The head, glitch and change bars are drawn on an `aria-hidden` canvas.
motion: With reduced motion, the code swaps at once without the glitch and the head jumps instead of springing; the green change bars remain.
notes: Built-in demo data: five checkpoints of one function (Start, Expiry, Rotate, Skew, Audit). It starts on the latest.
The component does not restore anything; `restore` reports the chosen checkpoint.

data.note: The five checkpoints and their code are invented; only `label` can be set.
